test_title: PYST 24: SSC GD Constable 2024 - English (Held On: 26 Feb, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: Intangible cultural heritage cuts across political, historical, community and culturel spheres.
Intangible cultural heritage cuts across political, historical, community and cultural spheres.
Intangible cultural heritage cuts across political, historical, comunity and cultural spheres.
Intangible cultural heritage cuts across polatical, historical, community and cultural spheres.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"cultural"** means relating to the ideas, customs, and social behavior of a society. (सांस्कृतिक)

 
 
• **Example:** The festival showcased the rich cultural heritage of the region.
 
 
 
• **"Cultural"** in the context of the sentence refers to different spheres influenced by culture. (सांस्कृतिक)
 
 
• **Example:** Intangible cultural heritage cuts across political, historical, community and cultural spheres.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word is **"cultural"**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: "culturel" **(सांस्कृतिक): This is a misspelling of the word "cultural".

 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: Intangible cultural heritage cuts across political, historical, community and culturel spheres.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: "comunity" **(समुदाय): This is a misspelling of the word "community".
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: Intangible cultural heritage cuts across political, historical, comunity and cultural spheres.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: "polatical" **(राजनीतिक): This is a misspelling of the word "political".
 
 
• **Example:** Incorrect: Intangible cultural heritage cuts across polatical, historical, community and cultural spheres.
